items.label: Spacious Storage
items.value: Measuring 15.7"D x 39.4"W x 19.9"H, this bench with storage features a large compartment and 2 fabric drawers, allowing you to neatly sort and store seasonal clothes, blankets, or pet supplies for an organized living space

items.label: Safe to Use, Easy to Move
items.value: Equipped with 2 safety hinges, the lid can stay open at any angle without suddenly slamming shut or pinching fingers. Side cut-out handles make it easy to lift and move the storage trunk wherever you need extra storage

items.label: Farmhouse Elegance
items.value: This entryway bench features a barn-door front panel and a rustic finish, bringing a warm and inviting vibe to your entryway, bedroom, or living room

items.label: Solid Construction
items.value: Crafted from sturdy particleboard with a reinforced bottom frame, this storage bench can hold up to 300 lb on top, so you can sit on the bench and change shoes with confidence

items.label: Versatile
items.value: Use it as an entryway shoe bench for footwear and grab-and-go essentials, a storage chest for books and daily items, or an end-of-bed bench for clothes and bedding—one piece to cover multiple storage needs
